status_note: Cue sheet by S11; nothing generated. The runner generates only the two one_off_cues (one take each, D-011) into this folder and logs credits in sound/manifest.jsonl; every other cue is a series library file from content/series1/sound/.
sources: content/series1/episodes/s1a01/script.en.json (same beat and line ids l01-l28; same silences)
content/series1/episodes/s1a01/voice/takes.hi.json (l22 note: the cough is an effect)
timebase: Anchored to beat and line ids, not seconds: no storyboard or measured takes exist yet. Offsets ('~1.5 s into the silence') are against the script's silent_seconds; S13 places every point effect against the measured voice and the edited shot lengths (D-014 rule 6, D-0M2). Both language cuts use the same cues and anchors; only line timings differ.

one_off_cues.prompt: A single quiet out-breath from a man in his thirties through the nose and slightly parted lips, a short soft exhale of expected relief, very close and dry, small still room at night, no words, no sigh voice, no music.
one_off_cues.why_not_library: The library lists Aditya's b1 out-breath as a voice take, but b1 has no Aditya line and voice/takes.hi.json has no take for it, so nobody records it. No breath cue exists in the library.
one_off_cues.fallback: Drop it: the picture (eyes lowering) carries the beat; leave the bed alone in the silence.

one_off_cues.prompt: A plump Indian woman in her fifties, a paan chewer, coughing two short wet chesty coughs at the end of a laugh, warm and amused, close and dry in a small room, no words, no music.
one_off_cues.why_not_library: The cough is one line in one episode. The library assigns it to the voice take, but S10's l22 take note says the voice is not asked for it and it is an effect.
one_off_cues.fallback: If it sounds like a different woman from Mausi's voice, drop it and let l22's laugh tail ring out; it is texture, not story.

ducking: l01: first line of the episode, spoken whole; bed ducked 6 dB, nothing else under it.
Ambience beds duck 6 dB and music 8 dB under ordinary lines.
l02 (Mausi on Kiran's speaker): bedroom bed ducks 8 dB.
l17-l19 (Mausi on Billu's speaker): car engine bed ducks 12 dB, drone 12 dB, pluck 14 dB.
l24 (the one whisper) and l25: bureau bed and street layer held still (no level move), keys and bangles only in the gaps; whisper dry and close.
l27-l28: duck everything right down (bureau -14 dB, street muted, drone net about -35 dB) so the chooda line is fully clear; the chooda click only in a gap.
Point effects never sit on a word; when a measured take moves, the effect moves to the nearest gap.
voice_processing: l02 (Mausi, Kiran's phone on speaker in the bedroom): light filter only, warm and fully clear: band-pass ~250-5000 Hz, very light saturation (lighter colour than the car).
l17, l19 (Mausi on Billu's phone on speaker over the gear lever): band-pass ~300-3400 Hz, light saturation, fully voiced, every consonant survives (library mix.phone_voice_fx).
l09-l12 (stairwell): short small concrete reverb, low send (mix setting).
l13-l16, l18, l20 (car): dry, slight in-car closeness; l20 is exterior at the car door: dry, no reverb.
l21-l28 (bureau): small room, dry; l24 whisper closest and driest of all.
b1 out-breath and l22 cough: matched to the adjacent voice's room and EQ.
silences: b1: 1.2 s after l02: call-ended beeps, then the out-breath; bed only otherwise.
b3: 1.2 s after l06: bed, drone and at most one far dog.
b8: 4.5 s, no line: engine bed, birds, road pluck; nothing else (the print sliding into the pocket is picture only; add a -26 dB slice of sfx_photo_print only if the edit holds on the hand).
b11: 3.0 s held set-up: room bed and drone held, all cut a frame before the last chink.
mix.no_fan: No ceiling fan in the bedroom, stairwell, lane or car mixes. amb_bureau_room carries a fan; it is allowed in the bureau (library mix.no_fan_rule) but pulled down, since the script names only the tube-light hum.
mix.trim_order_effect: If the edit applies the writer's trim order (b5 3.0 -> 2.0, b8 -> 2.5, b9 4.5 -> 3.5): b5 effects compress as noted on sfx_bolt_draw; b8 keeps bed, birds and pluck only; sfx_shutter_up starts ~1.2 s into b9's silence. If l12 becomes a laugh in the mix only, it is Billu's l12 take with the words removed, not a new cue.
mix.levels_note: level_db values are starting points relative to full scale before the -14 LUFS master; S13 sets final levels by measurement against dialogue.

fallback: Plan 7.8 and D-011 reuse: if a one-off fails or comes back unusable after its one take, drop it (both are texture; see each cue's fallback). If mus_road_pluck is missing, run mus_bed_drone alone under b7-b8 at -26 dB (library fallback). If all music fails, raise the bedroom bed 3 dB in b3-b5 and the car bed 2 dB in b7-b8; the bureau stays dry and the last chink still plays alone.
